subject: OrbitData — Dedicated capacity demo & throughput pre-check
messages:
From: Sam Wong <sam.wong@orbitdata.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@orbitdata.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity inquiry — sustained QPS / latency needs

Hi Maya / Ben,

We just completed the self-serve signup and selected the Dedicated capacity offering — thanks for the smooth flow. We want to line up a short demo + technical pre-check to make sure Redwood meets our production needs. High level requirements: 
- Sustained 150 QPS (requests are ~512 tokens on average)
- 99th percentile generation latency target < 250ms
- Support for prefix caching and a small KV cache for session continuity

We’re evaluating a 6-week POC and would like to validate throughput/latency on our sample dataset before committing. Available times next week: Tue 9/7 09:00–11:00 PT, Wed 9/8 13:00–16:00 PT, Thu 9/9 08:00–10:00 PT.

I attached the capacity spreadsheet with expected QPS bursts and test payload shapes (orbit_capacity_requirements.xlsx). Could you confirm what you need from our side to run a short smoke load test during the demo, and whether any special networking/VPC prep is required? Also looping in Priya (security) — she has a few questions about data residency.

Thanks,
Sam Wong
Head of Platform — OrbitData
sam.wong@orbitdata.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: orbit_capacity_requirements.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wong <sam.wong@orbitdata.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry — sustained QPS / latency needs

Hey Sam — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the detailed spreadsheet. Maya and I will run point on scheduling and getting the right folks on the call. Quick notes / asks before the demo: 

1) Slot selection — we can do Tue 9/7 09:30 PT or Wed 9/8 14:00 PT. Which works best?
2) Pre-check items for a meaningful throughput test: please share a 10–20 minute sample trace (JSON lines) and one representative request payload. If you prefer, a small DropBox/Drive link is fine.
3) Network/residency: Maya can confirm specifics, but in most Dedicated proofs we either run in Redwood Dedicated within your cloud account or via our private VPC peering. If you have a preference (VPC peering vs. hosted dedicated with encrypt-at-rest), flag it now and we’ll loop in infra.

Agenda suggestion (30–45 min): quick intro + product fit (10), ops/throughput smoke test (20), next steps & POC plan (5–15). If you want a deeper ops walkthrough we can schedule a follow up with Markus (SE) for a 60-min session.

I’ll tentatively hold Tue 9/7 09:30 PT on my calendar and send an invite once you confirm.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise SDR — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

--
Ben Carter
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Wong <sam.wong@orbitdata.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@orbitdata.com>, eng-team@orbitdata.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry — sustained QPS / latency needs

Thanks Ben — Tue 9/7 09:30 PT works for us.

Priya (cc) — for residency: we need the option to keep logs and audit artifacts in us-east-1; our production will run in GCP us-east4. If Redwood requires particular ports/protocols for VPC peering, let us know and we’ll open a pre-approved ticket with infra.

I uploaded a small sample trace and a representative request payload to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C (same folder I referenced in the form). The file names are: sample_trace_150qps.jsonl and sample_request.txt.

Also adding two people from our engineering team to the call in case we need to dig into telemetry during the smoke run.

See you Tue — please send the calendar invite and any pre-demo checklist.

Sam

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wong <sam.wong@orbitdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry — sustained QPS / latency needs

Hi Sam — thanks for confirming. I’m Markus (SE) and I’ll join the call to run the throughput smoke test and go over ops. A few concrete prep items so the demo is productive: 

Pre-demo checklist (what we need from OrbitData before Tue 9/7 09:30 PT):
- 10–20 minute sample trace (you uploaded sample_trace_150qps.jsonl — perfect)
- Representative request payload (sample_request.txt)
- A short list of 3–5 canonical prompts to use during the smoke run
- If doing VPC peering: CIDR ranges and a primary contact for infra (we’ll provide a peering ACL template)
- If using hosted Dedicated: confirmation of required region (you mentioned us-east-1).

What Redwood will provide on the call:
- 20-minute smoke run targeting 150 sustained QPS with live latency dashboard and token breakdown
- SLO/playbook overview (see attached redwood-slo-playbook.pdf)
- Suggested batching + cache knobs to hit your 99p < 250ms target

Logistics: I’ll send a calendar invite (invite.ics) that includes a 30-minute slot for the demo and an optional 60-minute deep-ops follow-up next week. If you anticipate a longer hands-on run, we can reserve a dedicated load-testing window with our infra team.

If anything changes on your side (times or attendees), reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Markus Klein
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
